An unroped Class 2 talus and scree walk up Flora's southwest ridge/slope — the peak's easiest line and by far its most commonly climbed route, reached via a multi-day off-trail approach from the Devore Creek Trail out of Stehekin.

overview: The standard route: a long trail approach over Buck Creek Pass and Pass No Pass, followed by an unroped scramble up grass, scree, and blocky class 2-3 rock on Fortress's broad southwest face / south ridge to the summit.

face: East slope / ESE ridge above Headlight Basin
overview: An alternate line up Fortune Peak's east side from Headlight Basin below Ingalls Pass; ascends moderate slopes (snow early season, talus/scree later) directly to the summit ridge.

route: Standard Route (Esmeralda Basin – Lake Ann Pass)
overview: A straightforward off-trail scramble up Fortune Peak's ridge from the pass above Lake Ann, reached via the Esmeralda Basin Trail and the trail toward Lake Ann; considered the peak's easiest and most commonly climbed line.

face: Southeast ridge/face of the summit block

overview: A long, mostly bolt-protected trad/slab line up 23 pitches on Garfield's West Peaks (Infinite Peak), one of the longest sport-oriented routes in the Cascades foothills.

overview: The original 1941 first-ascent line up Leaning Spire, a distinct 5,169 ft tower immediately west of Garfield's true summit.

face: The great slabs on the south side of the West Peaks (tops out on the 4,804 ft sub-summit)
overview: A 13-pitch, Grade IV trad line up a sub-summit rock near Garfield's West Peak, established solo in 1999.

rock_grade: Class 4 scrambling on the standard line; a short 5.4 pitch on Beckey's optional 'Chimney Variation'

face: Southwest side of the West Peaks (tops out on the 4,804 ft sub-summit, 'Infinite Peak')
overview: A complex, mostly unroped class-4 scramble linking several historical lines up ledges to the top of Infinite Peak, Garfield's West Peaks sub-summit.

rock_grade: 5th class, easy to moderate (FA account: 'easy to moderate fifth-class pitches')
face: South and west sides of the peak (route avoids the peak's much steeper east face)
overview: Ghost Peak is a Northern Pickets summit near Crooked Thumb and Challenger, completing the spectral naming theme of the range. Its infrequent ascents make it a quiet objective for those deep in the Pickets.

route: Disappointment Peak Cleaver (Gerdine Ridge / Cool Glacier)
overview: The Gerdine Ridge and Cool Glacier route climbs Glacier Peak's south side, typically via the White Pass and Glacier Gap. It is a popular alternative to the Sitkum, often combined with a scenic high traverse beneath the peak.
